---
name: Plugin request
about: Ask for AIHawk to apply on a job site it does not know yet
title: "Plugin: "
---

**Do not paste personal data.** No CV, name, e-mail address or sign-in.

**Site name and address** (the site or the careers pages it hosts, such as `jobs.example.com`):

**An example posting URL**, public, that AIHawk should be able to apply on:

**What the application form is like**: one page or several steps, whether the form is on the posting or at another address, any captcha or sign-in.

**Do you have a plugin already?** A plugin is a Markdown file that tells the model how the site's form works. See docs/plugins.md. If you wrote one, say whether you tried it on a real posting and what the form did. A plugin is welcome as a pull request, once it has been tried.
